title: Chennai Ke Industrialist Ne Tirumala Mandir Ko Diya 121 Kg Gold, Value ₹206 Crore
summary: Chennai ke businessman Vardhman Jain aur unki patni ne Tirumala Balaji mandir mein kareeb 206 crore rupaye ke 121 kg sone ke gehne daan kiye hain.
key_points: Industrialist Vardhman Jain aur unki patni Radhika ne Tirupati mein 121 kg gold ornaments arpit kiye.
In gehno ki total value lagbhag 206 se 207 crore rupaye aanki gayi hai.
Collection mein 106 kg Lord Venkateswara ke liye aur 15 kg Goddess Padmavathi ke liye shamil hai.
Yeh daan Andhra Pradesh ke Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu ki maujoodgi mein diya gaya.
body: Chennai ke industrialist Vardhman Jain aur unki patni Radhika Jain ne Andhra Pradesh ke Tirumala mandir mein Lord Venkateswara ko 121 kg sone ke gehne bhet kiye hain. Is daan ki kul keemat lagbhag 206 se 207.6 crore rupaye tak batayi ja rahi hai. Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams (TTD) ke anusaar yeh mandir ke modern itihaas ke sabse bade donations mein se ek hai.

Is khaas offering mein lagbhag 46 tarah ke traditional gehne shamil hain. Inme se 106 kg ke aabhushan Lord Venkateswara ke liye aur 15 kg ka sone ka vastra Goddess Padmavathi ke liye taiyar kiya gaya hai. In gehno mein ek sona ka crown (kireetam), kamarbandh, har, payal aur bazu-bandh jaise kayi items shamil hain. Sath hi in aabhushano mein kareeb 238 carats ke heere aur ruby, emerald jaise keemti ratna bhi jade hue hain.

Yeh offering Andhra Pradesh ke Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu ki presence mein TTD ke priests aur officials ko saupi gayi. CM Naidu ne is daan ko ek aitihasik pal bataya aur kaha ki yeh bhagwan ke prati bhakto ki atoot shraddha ko darshata hai.

Reports ke mutabik yeh sabhi ornaments Chennai mein mandir ki zarooraton aur traditional design ke hisab se banwaye gaye the. Mandir administration in aabhushano ko aane wale rituals ke dauran bhagwan ke shringar ke liye istemal karega.
why_it_matters: Tirumala Balaji mandir duniya ke sabse prasiddh aur ameer dharmik sthalo mein se ek hai. Aise bade daan se mandir ke aitihasik collection mein izafa hota hai aur yeh desh bhar ke shraddhaluon ke vishwas ko darshata hai.
